```text
netpulse config init [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--path <PATH>` | Where to write it (default: ./netpulse.toml) |
| `--force` | Overwrite an existing file |

Also accepts the [global options](index.md#global-options) `--config <FILE>` and `--json`.
